ui.providers.phone.consent: Activating sets up this Radient account’s tunnel subscription at USD {amount} a month, reserves your phone address and starts the background connector. It does not purchase credit.
ui.providers.phone.failure.check: Phone access could not be checked, and nothing was changed.
ui.providers.phone.failure.run: Phone access setup could not finish. Steps already completed are not undone. Check again before retrying.
ui.providers.phone.heading: Phone access
ui.providers.phone.outcome.billing_activ: Billing: subscription activation completed; this has not been undone.
ui.providers.phone.outcome.billing_alrea: Billing: the subscription was already active.
ui.providers.phone.outcome.billing_not_a: Billing: the current subscription still needs activation.
ui.providers.phone.outcome.billing_uncon: Billing: activation was requested but its outcome is unconfirmed. Check the account before retrying; do not assume rollback.
ui.providers.phone.outcome.reservation_s: Phone address: reservation saved on this computer; retry reuses it.
ui.providers.phone.outcome.reservation_u: Phone address: reservation outcome unconfirmed; retry uses the saved request key.
ui.providers.phone.signing_in: Finish signing in in your browser. This updates on its own when you are done.
ui.providers.phone.use_address: Open the URL above and sign in with the same Radient account.
